findings.message: Supplier Tax Registration Number (TRN) is missing or malformed.
findings.fix: Request the supplier's 15-digit TRN and reprint the invoice. Per FTA VAT Guide, every VAT-registered supplier must show TRN on every tax invoice.
findings.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Tax Invoice requirements

findings.message: Sum of line-level VAT does not match the invoice's stated total VAT.
findings.fix: Recompute VAT per line at the stated rate and reconcile to the printed total. A mismatch is a red flag during FTA audit.
findings.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Calculation of Tax

findings.message: Stated VAT total is internally inconsistent with line-level VAT computations.
findings.fix: Verify each line's VAT amount matches (quantity x unit price x rate / 100). The grand total may reconcile but individual lines may be wrong — this is a common hallucination pattern when OCR misreads a single digit.
findings.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Calculation of Tax (per-line)

findings.message: Stated invoice total does not equal subtotal + VAT.
findings.fix: Verify the printed total. It must equal subtotal plus VAT. A mismatch indicates a misread or misprint — recheck the source document before filing.
findings.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Calculation of Tax

findings.message: Invoice is in a currency other than AED.
findings.fix: For UAE domestic supplies, AED is expected. For foreign-currency invoices, ensure the exchange rate used is the FTA-published daily rate for the invoice date.
findings.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Currency & Exchange Rates
